items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: Henry Morgan was very funny, oh yeah. This Mad thing, the orchestra is fantastic.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m pretty sure. One of those two. Henry Morgan was very funny, oh yeah. This Mad thing, the orchestra is fantastic. Absolutely fantastic. There again it’s all funny, but legitimate playing. Oh yes. All legitimate playing. Fast tonguing, fast this and that. And I think most of the time he used Ray Crisara. Ray is still alive as far as I know. He teaches in Austin, Texas, at the University of Austin. I did a concert there in 1990, June of — no, 1980.

When you — I’m going to leap ahead a little bit — but you’ve seen an awful lot of changes in this country: technology and social issues and all that. Are there certain things that stand out in your head as being really memorable and unbelievable changes over the years?
